title: Fine structure investigation and laser cooling study of the LaH molecule
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41699-41709
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02708J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nariman Abu El Kher, Nayla El-Kork, Nissrin Alharzali, Joumana Assaf, Mahmoud Korek
A theoretical feasibility study of the spin–orbit laser cooling of the molecule LaH has been performed using CASSCF/MRCI ab initio calculations with Davidson correction in the Λ(±) and Ω(±) representations.
